evals.prompt: Check the status and department of the RuoYi user named admin.
evals.expected_output: Run ruoyi user:list --name admin, then summarize the read-only result.

evals.prompt: List the roles in RuoYi and check whether an admin role exists.
evals.expected_output: Run ruoyi role:list with a suitable filter and summarize matching roles.

evals.prompt: RuoYi says browser credentials were rejected. Recover the login and continue the user query.
evals.expected_output: Run ruoyi login --refresh with a command timeout of at least 330 seconds, tell the user to complete the browser CAPTCHA if needed, then rerun the original user query once; never expose a token.
